name: SpikeStrip
concept: Police stinger for 1989 Everon: a folding tyre-deflation strip an officer carries folded, lays across the road in front of a fleeing car and picks up again. Deployed it is about 3.5 m of low hinged links with two rows of hollow steel spikes; a wheel that crosses it goes flat, so the car slows and pulls to that side. The generator makes one link; the clean stage repeats it seven times along the length and stacks the same seven for the folded bundle.
prompt: A flat low rectangular road plate, 50 cm long, 30 cm wide and 4 cm thick, lying flat on the ground. Two straight rows of short sharp upright steel spikes stand on its top face, seven spikes in each row along the length. A round hinge tube runs across each short end of the plate. Square edges, low profile, nothing above the spikes. Police stinger tyre-deflation strip segment from the 1980s. Clean hard-surface industrial design, single object, no text, no logos, no hands, no stand.
texture_prompt: Matte black hard rubber base plate with light road scuffs, dull bare steel spikes, zinc-plated steel hinge tubes, no text, no logos, flat neutral lighting.
